description_en: Enables or shuts down the single sign-on (SSO) feature for an AD-based office network
description_zh: 为基于AD账号的办公网络开启或关闭单点登录SSO功能
kebab_example: aliyun ecd set-directory-sso-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --directory-id cn-hangzhou+dir-h95efs1mbukd90000 --enable-sso true --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDirectorySsoStatus

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AD office network
parameters.name: directory_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable or shutdown SSO logon
parameters.help_zh: 开启或者关闭单点登录SSO
parameters.name: enable_sso
